scope: Alt+Space and Meta+Alt+Space open Launchpad search.

checks.command: Press Alt+Space in light mode and Meta+Alt+Space in dark mode in both installed editions. Verify KWin shows the floating Launchpad search and Apps windows, type into search, and dismiss the popup.
Seed the previous Meta+Alt+Space-only assignment in the Tahoe guest and verify both physical shortcuts after installation.

coverage_limits: Disposable KDE neon Plasma 6.8.1 Wayland guests at 2x scale. The previous shortcut assignment was explicitly seeded in Tahoe.
